organization: Department of Business Development (DBD), Ministry of Commerce
rate_limits: per-company by 13-digit juristic ID; no documented bulk enumeration; no token observed
notes: OPEN official company API (no key). GET /api/v1/juristic_person/{13-digit}. Returns id, name TH/EN, type, register date, status, TSIC objective (code+TH/EN), register & paid-up capital (THB), branch, structured address (province/district/subdistrict codes). Verified live: PTT (0107544000108), Bangkok Bank (0107536000374), CP All (0107542000011), INET (0107544000094). 13-digit juristic ID = company id = Tax ID. Per-company lookup; no open bulk enumeration found. Directors/shareholders NOT in this endpoint (PDPA).

source_name: DBD DataWarehouse — company profiles + financial statements
rate_limits: per-company; login/session required; returned 302/403 for automation
notes: DBD's company-profile + FINANCIAL-STATEMENT warehouse (balance sheet / income statement, filed annually by all juristic persons, plus ratios). The richest financial source, but login/session-gated (302/403 for automated/API access). Currency THB. Catalogued from public knowledge; no values copied.

rate_limits: CKAN API; WAF 'Access Denied' (403) for automated requests from this environment
notes: National CKAN open-data portal (DGA). Hosts DBD juristic-person datasets, but the portal + CKAN API returned HTTP 403 'Access Denied' (WAF) for automated requests from this environment. Likely usable from a Thai/allowed network; could not confirm datasets headless.

source_name: SET — Stock Exchange of Thailand (listed financials)
notes: Stock Exchange of Thailand — listed-company financial statements and disclosures (public via browser). Listed companies only; complements the DBD OpenAPI (which carries capital but not full statements).
